post.title: Looking for a Quest Writer.
post.body:
Looking for a writer willing to help me create a Riordan-verse based quest, set on an idea I’ve had for a while. It would require frequent writing, meeting word count deadlines and being creative in how they wrote. Knowledge of Rick Riordan’s work is likely required.

I will pay by word count and will go up to $15 for 4000 words.

analysis.summary: Looking for a writer to help create a Riordan-verse based quest and meet word count deadlines.

expect: does not agree to $15 for 4,000 words
does not claim familiarity with Rick Riordan's books or fan-fiction experience
